projects.name: FitFolio AI Closet
projects.description: A local-first virtual dressing room: catalog your closet, get occasion-based outfit picks, and preview looks with optional AI try-on. Screenshots below are the real running app with demo data.
projects.objective: Cut the daily "what do I wear" tax: give one person a fast, private way to see their whole closet, get dressed for the occasion, and try looks before committing.
projects.problem: Deciding what to wear wastes time and money — closets fill with unworn clothes while mornings fill with outfit indecision. Existing tools upload your photos to someone else's cloud.
projects.solution: A local-first virtual closet. Photos stay in the browser's localStorage; an occasion rules engine ("Dress Me Today") suggests outfits; compare up to 3 looks side by side; optional single-garment AI try-on renders a preview.
projects.technology: Dependency-free Node API serving a zero-build static UI (plain HTML/JS/CSS). AI try-on runs server-side so the key never touches the browser. Covered by a 29-check smoke contract in the repo.
projects.honestLimits: Working prototype. AI Generate requires a server-side key — without one it shows an explanatory message, never a fake image. Photos are local-only (clear site data before shared captures). Single user; no accounts, no sharing, no payments.

projects.name: iDealHope Recovery
projects.description: A recovery-support platform: searchable resources, consultation and appointment requests, client goal tracking, and a specialist dashboard. Screenshots below are the real running app with synthetic demo data.
projects.objective: Lower the first-step barrier: make it easy for someone seeking recovery support — or their family — to find help, ask for a consultation, and track progress in one calm place.
projects.problem: Finding addiction and mental-health support is overwhelming at the hardest moment: scattered listings, unclear costs, and no clear next step toward a real person.
projects.solution: A single platform: public resource directory (10+ seeded listings with search, category, and cost filters), validated consultation + appointment request flows, client portal with goals, and a specialist dashboard for clients, consultations, and appointments — with the 988 crisis line always visible.
projects.technology: Node API serving a static UI with a JSON file store. Seeded specialist/client demo logins; salted-hash auth with role gates; 31-check smoke suite green.
projects.honestLimits: Working prototype with 100% synthetic data — listings are not real providers, and no real patient data may ever be entered. Explicitly NOT HIPAA or 42 CFR Part 2 assessed: needs formal legal/security review, a BAA chain, encryption at rest, secure cookies, and a real session store before any clinical use. Contact-request only — no real-time or secure messaging. Educational content is informational only, not diagnoses or treatment. Not an emergency monitoring service.

projects.name: Sacred Path Guidance
projects.description: A 12-page tarot and spiritual-guidance booking site: services, live availability, double-booking-safe reservations, and a token-gated owner dashboard. Screenshots below are the real running site with sample data.
projects.objective: Give a spiritual practitioner one home base: explain the offerings, let seekers check availability and request readings, and manage everything from a private dashboard — no patchwork of tools.
projects.problem: Bookings arrived by DM, availability lived in someone's head, and double-bookings happened. There was no single place to show services, take requests, and track clients.
projects.solution: A full marketing site plus booking engine: 12 public pages (home, readings, guidance, about, testimonials, pricing, privacy, terms), services + availability APIs, server-side double-booking prevention, spam-protected contact, and an owner dashboard for bookings, messages, testimonials, FAQs, and settings.
projects.technology: Dependency-free Node API serving static pages. Token-gated owner dashboard; honeypot + rate limiting on contact; moon-phase display clearly labeled as an approximation. 38/38 smoke checks green.
projects.honestLimits: Working prototype — the strongest of the three builds. Honest limits: no payments are collected (paymentStatus: not_collected); no email sending — bookings and messages persist for the owner to follow up. Testimonials ship as 3 clearly-labeled SAMPLE placeholders the owner replaces. Screenshots show public pages only; the admin dashboard is never published.
